failure_class_definitions.SCHEMA: JSON or pydantic schema validation failed for a KG or config artifact.
failure_class_definitions.IDENTIFIER: Unknown or unresolved disease identifier (slug, MONDO, EFO).
failure_class_definitions.MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA: Required config field or KG file absent or empty.
failure_class_definitions.LEGACY_FORMAT: Deprecated field names or legacy-only data shapes.
failure_class_definitions.DANGLING_REFERENCE: Relationship or config references an entity not in the module.
failure_class_definitions.VALIDATOR_BUG: Validation rule misfire; fix the framework not the module.
failure_class_definitions.SOURCE_VARIANCE: Upstream source drift; may be acceptable with review.
